title: Minecraft MOTD Generator | Colors, Formatting & Live Preview
description: Create a Minecraft server MOTD with colors, formatting, examples, and live preview. Copy the output for your server.properties file.
intro: Write a custom server message of the day, add Minecraft color codes, preview it, and copy the result for your server.properties file.
howTo: Type the text you want players to see in the multiplayer server list.
Use color and formatting buttons to insert Minecraft formatting codes.
Copy the output and paste it after motd= inside server.properties.
Restart or reload your server so the new MOTD appears in the server list.
faqs: A Minecraft MOTD is the message shown below your server name in the multiplayer server list.
Where do I put the MOTD?
For a normal Java server, paste the output into the motd setting inside server.properties.
Can I use colors in a server MOTD?
Yes. Many Java server setups support legacy color and formatting codes such as &a, &b, &l, and &r.
Does vanilla MOTD support RGB hex colors?
Vanilla server.properties MOTD support is limited. Many modern proxy or plugin setups support richer formats, but test before publishing.
